headline: A 2008 executive order changed an earlier order, Executive Order 12962, which deals with federal policy on recreational fishing.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12962, a 1995 order that sets federal policy on recreational fishing. No official summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here. It affects how federal agencies carry out the earlier order.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that manage fish, waters, or public lands
who_it_affects.how: These agencies must follow the updated version of Executive Order 12962.
They may be affected by changes in how federal agencies handle recreational fishing, though the details are not given in the source material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 26, 2008; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
